extra_limitations: The evidence comes from published NGSIM vehicle trajectories (Lankershim Boulevard, 2005-06-16 08:30-08:45), not from camera tracking; no camera calibration is used.

The signal timeline and program are estimated from stop-line discharges: green onsets and ends are approximated; yellow 4 s, start-up 2 s, clearance 1 s and minimum green 5 s are assumed. The real control appears actuated (onset spacing 80-201 s); the simulation repeats one observed 99 s cycle.
Queue lengths marked 'at least' reach the end of the observed lane; cross-street queues are observable only near the limit line (east) or not at all (west).
In the simulation right turns may go on red after stopping (assumed).
